platform_info.name: Google
platform_info.description: Handles the Google Takeout archive, uploaded as one or more zip parts (a multi-zip archive-set, so the export never needs to fit in a single upload). Extracts 12 tables: four from YouTube (watch history, search history, subscriptions, comments), one each from Search, Chrome, Video Search, Ads, Discover and Google News, and two from News — the News product's My Activity stream and its own export (followed sources, topics and locations, saved articles and magazines). Each source is read as JSON, HTML, CSV or TXT, whichever format it was exported in, which may differ per source within one archive. Handles DDPs in English, Dutch, German, Spanish, Arabic, Turkish and Chinese (Simplified only); the seven locales' path tables for the core sources were verified against real Google Takeout exports in August 2026. A handful of lower-traffic sources still carry older, unverified path guesses: the News My-Activity folder in every locale, Discover outside English (its English path is real-export-verified), and subscriptions/comments outside English and Dutch. Tested against the project's synthetic/canary test suite as of the date below; a live browser run against real exports updates this note when performed. If you find anything wrong with this script, report to datadonation@uu.nl and it will be fixed!

description.en: This table shows the videos you watched on YouTube, sorted over time. Explore it to discover patterns in your viewing habits — what you watch most, and when.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de video's die u op YouTube heeft bekeken, gesorteerd op tijd. Verken ze om patronen in uw kijkgedrag te ontdekken — wat u het meest kijkt en wanneer.

title.nl: Bekeken video's in de loop van de tijd

title.en: Videos watched by hour of the day
title.nl: Bekeken video's per uur van de dag

title.en: Words in video titles you watched
title.nl: Woorden in titels van bekeken video's

documentation.summary: Each row represents one video the participant watched on YouTube, including the video title and URL, the channel that published it, how the view came about where the archive says so, and the timestamp.
documentation.source_file: the YouTube watch history, e.g. history/watch-history.json or Verlauf/Wiedergabeverlauf.html

columns.Title: Title of the watched video.
columns.Channel name: Name of the channel that published the video, empty when the archive does not name one.
columns.Channel URL: URL of the channel that published the video, empty when the archive does not link to one.
columns.Details: How the view came about, such as a video watched from an ad. Empty for most videos.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the video was watched.

description.en: This table shows what you searched for on YouTube. Your search terms reveal your interests, curiosities, and how you use the platform to find content.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont wat u op YouTube heeft gezocht. Uw zoektermen onthullen uw interesses, nieuwsgierigheid en hoe u het platform gebruikt om content te vinden.

title.en: Words in your YouTube search history

columns.Title: Description of the search action.

description.en: Comments you posted on YouTube videos. These are the conversations you participated in across the platform.
